source.code:
/-- Type class for the `+ᵥ` notation. -/
class VAdd (G : Type u) (P : Type v) where
  /-- `a +ᵥ b` computes the sum of `a` and `b`. The meaning of this notation is type-dependent,
  but it is intended to be used for left actions. -/
  vadd : G → P → P
